title: Poems from the Divan of Hafiz
author: Hafiz (Gertrude Bell trans)
description: Gertrude Bell's translations introduce the lyric poetry of Hafiz. Wine, gardens, longing and the beloved become vehicles for reflection on love, spiritual freedom and the ambiguity between earthly and divine desire.
